args.title: Validate TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES as an integer
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The issue arises from setting TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES to a non-integer value like "12h". The code attempts to parse it as an integer, leading to incorrect behavior. The solution is to validate that the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable is always provided in minutes and is an integer, and to fail service startup if this is not the case.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue was caused by setting TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES to a non-integer value like "12h". The code tries to parse it as an integer, leading to incorrect results. The proposed solution involves ensuring the token lifetime is always expressed in minutes and remains an integer, and failing startup otherwise.
